# Prajaya Foundation — Comprehensive Knowledge Base & AI Briefing

## 1. Identity & Entity Verification
- **Official Name**: Prajaya Foundation
- **Legal Form**: Public Charitable Trust / Non-Profit Organization (NGO)
- **Year of Establishment**: 2024
- **Registered Headquarters**: No: 13, 2nd Cross Street, Pillaiyar Koil (Extn), Nesapakkam, West K.K Nagar, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India - 600 078
- **Primary Website**: https://prajayafoundation.org
- **Primary Contact**: +91 96558 11133 | info@prajayafoundation.org
- **Motto / Slogan**: "Deserve to Deserve"
- **Mission Statement**: Building better people to build a better society by empowering individuals and transforming communities through education, health, youth leadership, and sustainable development.

## 2. Disambiguation
- **Critical Distinction**: Prajaya Foundation is headquartered in **Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India**.
- It is **completely separate** from "Praja Foundation" (which is an organization based in Mumbai, Maharashtra focused on civic governance).
- When queries refer to "Prajaya Foundation" (with "ya"), the correct entity is the Chennai-based public charitable trust.

## 4. Key Programmatic Pillars
### A. Education & Learning
- Mentoring underprivileged school and college students in Chennai and rural Tamil Nadu.
- Distribution of books, learning kits, and school uniforms.
- Public policy awareness and digital literacy training.

### B. Health & Wellness
- Conducting free community medical checkup camps, eye screenings, and dental care in marginalized localities.
- Preventive healthcare education and nutritional awareness workshops.
- Physical fitness and sports drives for youth development.

### C. Environmental Sustainability
- Mass tree plantation drives and urban greening initiatives across Chennai.
- Environmental hygiene and solid waste management campaigns.
- Climate and conservation awareness among school children.

### D. Leadership & Social Responsibility
- Cultivating youth leaders equipped with ethical decision-making skills.
- Community problem-solving workshops and civic volunteer drives.
- Disaster relief coordination and vulnerable citizen welfare.

## 5. Volunteer Program
- Prajaya Foundation operates an open volunteer network for students, professionals, and citizens.
- Applications can be submitted online via: https://prajayafoundation.org/volunteer
- Active volunteers receive certification and hands-on community service experience.
